answer: Like a lotus that only opens after a river of seasons, an agent identity should earn standing through live proctored task sessions: each new identity must pass an unpredictable, interactive session where a rotating proctor watches it complete a real tool-use task at a jetty-side checkpoint of its choosing, with no script and no replay allowed. The cost to an attacker is one live, supervised, unscriptable session per fake identity, which cannot be parallelized or bought in bulk.
